title: Geller teleported from New York City to Ossining
place_text: New York City to Ossining, New York

tellings.quote: teleported. So, he was walking down the street in New York City 1973, I think.

plain: A man named Uri Geller was walking down a street in New York City, around 1973, and was teleported to Ossining, a town up the Hudson River in New York state. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells it, giving the year as "1973, I think", and he ties it to a man named Andrija Puharich, who worked with Geller, and to a home movie Puharich shot on Super 8 film of a screened porch. If true, it would mean Geller's body moved miles in an instant.
